compatibility.linuxQt: v1 writer + separate TS + muxed TS segments + fMP4 H264/AAC + WebM VP9/Opus

resolvedLinuxFixtureFailure.cause: Missing absolute FOXICMP_TEST_MEDIA; WebM fixture lookup relative to CTest build directory

initialCorrections: Classic reserves about one second before the safe tail; a hard 12-second position threshold was replaced with a bounded distance from actual availableSeconds. The runtime behavior was preserved.

Separate/muxed/growing TS Qt test rows initially reused one temporary profile/control filename. Their working prefixes now include the media mode, and both Qt runtime/compatibility suites were rerun successfully.
The first Linux native CTest invocation lacked an absolute fixture environment. All eleven unaffected suites passed; the single failed WebM suite was rerun with FOXICMP_TEST_MEDIA and passed.
limitations: Known-duration VOD, one continuous scalar resource and exactly two required AVC/AAC logical views; no catalog/live/configuration change/clock rollover or arbitrary TS codecs/programs.
Growing indexes and immutable snapshots are copied per admitted update; multi-hour startup/performance and maximum index capacity have not been stress-tested.
Strict transport/codec framing is not full entropy validation; real decoders remain authoritative.
Native decoded hashes and timestamp comparison do not measure physical output synchronization.
Windows application builds were tested with separate profiles; installed Windows EXEs/INIs were not replaced.
